headline: Callahan's Passage Foothold Expands Amid Escalating Clashes in Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Colonial forces have expanded their hard-fought toehold in Callahan’s Passage to two strategic bases, driving sharp engagements around Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage. Along the western front in Nevish Line, contested ground has solidified into two Colonial strongholds against six Warden bastions, with combat rates accelerating once more near Blackcoat Way and Princefal. Weathered Expanse endures as the conflict’s bloodiest sector, logging a sharp surge in fresh casualties over the past hour as Crow’s Nest and Frostmarch repeatedly trade blows. To the east, Stlican Shelf remains intensely fractured, with one position battered into no-man's-land while clashes persist over Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town. In Linn of Mercy, combat has abruptly flared anew around Lathair with heavy Warden losses, even as the ferocious grinding in Stonecradle begins to cool following hours of relentless attrition across the central line.
